fast.type: Sunnah fast · Ayyamul Bidh (white days) day 1 + Monday
fast.why: Today is Monday and the 13th, the first white day. Next: fast the 14th (Tue 24 Nov) and 15th (Wed 25 Nov). Niyyah before Subuh (Shafi'i).

blessing: The people who put up with your tired days: family and colleagues who still make space for you. Today, thank one of them in words and make dua for them.

verse.text: Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity.

hadith.text: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent."

lesson.title: Adab: guarding the tongue
lesson.text: Good speech is part of iman. The Prophet ﷺ linked speaking good or staying silent directly to belief in Allah and the Last Day (Bukhari 6018). When you are scolded or stressed, pausing before replying is sunnah-aligned adab and protects your reward. Try one calm sentence today instead of a sharp one.

name.text: "Indeed, You are the Bestower (Al-Wahhab)" (3:8). He gives without being owed; ask Him for what you need today.
"Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider" (51:58). Rest tonight knowing your rizq is written.

world.text: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists set it at 85 seconds to midnight on 27 Jan 2026, the closest ever, citing nuclear risk, AI and great-power rivalry.
Forecasters' chance of a 'World War Three' before 2050 (10M+ deaths, major powers involved).
Prof Jiang's latest lectures on geopolitics and where great-power conflict is heading.

Nuclear deterrence makes all-out war a losing move for every major power, so the stable outcome (flashing) is 'compete, don't fight': trade wars, arms races and proxy conflicts. The real danger is a misread in a crisis like Taiwan or Ukraine, which is why the clock and the forecast are rising. Meter: 2 of 5.
world.note: My own illustrative model, not a forecast from a source.
